remission.title: Stable / Comfortable Condition
remission.message: Great news! Your logs indicate gut stability today. Keep up your healthy habits and self-care routine.
remission.care_habits: Maintain a balanced diet and regular daily hydration.
remission.care_medication: Continue routine therapy as prescribed by your doctor.

mild.title: Mild Symptoms Logged
mild.message: We noted mild changes today. Stay well hydrated, avoid foods that may irritate your gut, and keep tracking your bowel movements.
mild.care_hydration: Drink at least 2 to 3 liters of water and fluids throughout the day.
mild.care_diet: Avoid greasy foods, ultra-processed items, excess caffeine, and lactose if sensitive.
mild.care_monitor: Monitor your notes if symptoms persist for more than 48 hours.

flare.title: Notable Symptoms Logged
flare.message: We noted changes in your bowel routine. Take a deep breath, flare-up days happen. Please review these comfort tips below:
flare.care_hydration: Stay hydrated with water, oral rehydration solutions, or electrolyte drinks.
flare.care_no_nsaids: Advisory note: Remember to consult your doctor before taking common NSAIDs (like ibuprofen).
flare.care_contact_doctor: Share your increased frequency or bleeding notes with your gastroenterologist.
flare.care_red_flags: If you experience fever over 38°C (100.4°F), severe dizziness, or extreme fatigue, consider seeking in-person medical care.

poolingMorning.title: Morning Pooling
poolingMorning.message: During overnight rest, blood and secretions can naturally collect in the rectal vault. Passing this upon waking is common and does not necessarily indicate continuous active bleeding.
poolingMorning.action: Monitor subsequent entries throughout the day calmly.

tenesmusSupport.title: Urgency Sensation (Tenesmus)
tenesmusSupport.message: Rectal sensitivity can create an intense sensation of needing to go even with little or no output. This is a common experience during inflammation.
tenesmusSupport.action: Take a deep breath. This entry has been saved to your timeline.

emergency.title: Attention to Recorded Symptoms
emergency.message: You logged intense discomfort combined with other physical symptoms (such as acute pain, dizziness, or weakness). Do not hesitate to seek in-person medical care or prompt emergency evaluation if needed.
emergency.care_hospital: Consider contacting your doctor or heading to a nearby healthcare center.
emergency.care_hydration: Sip water or oral electrolyte solution in small sips during transport.
emergency.care_no_nsaids: Advisory: Remember to consult a physician before using common pain relievers (NSAIDs).
emergency.care_monitor: You can show this symptom journal or export the PDF summary to assist your care team.
